svg.text: Build clarity and proof first. Add content and distribution only after the foundation works.
FICTIONAL RUNNING EXAMPLE · 5 HOURS PER WEEK

g.text: Buyer language · Position · Homepage/profile message · Offer page · First proof asset
The system begins with what the buyer should understand and believe—not with posting volume.
Case study · Content map · First substantial asset · Primary distribution rhythm
One useful asset is built around a real buyer question, then distributed where the buyer already pays attention.
Lead capture · Welcome sequence · Second priority asset · Measurement · Monthly diagnosis
The next marketing move is chosen from evidence rather than from a new trend or platform.
~3 hours build · 1 hour distribute/participate · 1 hour research/review
Deliberately ignore new channels and formats until the core system is running.
